About JOR Active Retired Tours Ireland

As a company, our objective is very simple: we want to deliver to you and your guests the best possible active retired tour experience with lasting memories. The word ‘No’ does not exist in our vocabulary as we believe where there is a will there is a way! We look forward to working with you and your guests.
